result.response:
I have completed the task.

### Root Cause
In [`SimplexTableau.dropPhase1Objective`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/math_33_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/math3/optimization/linear/SimplexTableau.java#L327-L342), when removing positive-cost non-artificial columns after Phase 1, the check compared entries using `maxUlps` (`Precision.compareTo(entry, 0d, maxUlps) > 0`) instead of the user-configured `epsilon` (`Precision.compareTo(entry, 0d, epsilon) > 0`). This caused non-artificial decision variable columns with near-zero values resulting from floating-point rounding errors to be prematurely dropped from the tableau, locking valid decision variables to zero and yielding suboptimal solutions.
